name: Notta
summary: AI note taker that records, transcribes, translates and summarises meetings and audio files.
description: Notta records online meetings through a bot or on-device without a bot, transcribes uploaded audio, and turns speech into notes and summaries in several languages. A Free plan is available; Pro and Business are paid tiers.

pricing.label: Freemium
pricing.note: 7 €/mo (Pro, billed annually; 83.99 €/year). Business 15.83 €/mo billed annually (189.99 €/year). Official EUR prices. A free plan at 0 € is offered.

howToUse.title: Open Notta
howToUse.description: Open Notta and start on the Free plan, or upgrade to Pro or Business when you need more capacity.

howToUse.title: Record or upload
howToUse.description: Record an online meeting with the bot, or record on the device without a bot. You can also transcribe uploaded audio, video or YouTube links.

howToUse.title: Read summaries and translate
howToUse.description: Open the summaries and action items Notta produces, and turn on real-time translation when more than one language is spoken.

howToUse.title: Use Memo, screen recording or MCP
howToUse.description: Attach the Memo hardware recorder to a phone to record calls and in-person meetings, or use screen recording, the desktop app and the MCP connector.

features: AI note taker that records, transcribes, translates and summarises meetings and audio files.
Notta records online meetings through a bot or on-device without a bot, transcribes uploaded audio, video and YouTube links, and produces summaries and action items.
It also offers real-time translation, screen recording, a desktop app, an MCP connector and a hardware recorder.
A Free plan is available; Pro and Business are paid tiers.
features_fr: Preneur de notes IA qui enregistre, transcrit, traduit et résume les réunions et les fichiers audio.
Notta enregistre les réunions en ligne via un robot ou sur un appareil sans robot, transcrit les liens audio, vidéo et YouTube téléchargés, et produit des résumés et des actions.
Il propose également une traduction en temps réel, un enregistrement d'écran, une application de bureau, un connecteur MCP et un enregistreur matériel.
Une offre gratuite est disponible ; Pro et Business sont des forfaits payants.
